$comment: Generated from lib/writing-schema.ts by `npm run generate:schemas` — do not edit by hand.
title: Writing Activity YAML
description: Schema for a writing activity: a split-screen Markdown editor with an AI writing coach.

id.description: Short machine-readable activity id, e.g. human-animal-short-story.

name.description: Optional human-readable title (used as a label).

title.description: Optional greeting shown to students on the welcome screen instead of the default message.

description.description: Optional description shown to students below the welcome greeting (Markdown).

anonymous.description: Writing DIVERGES: it defaults to false (attributed), because review and the Save feature need to know whose text it is. Set to true for ephemeral, unattributed writing — which also disables saving.

fragment_files.description: Optional fragment libraries this activity pulls shared prompt fragments from.

fragments.description: Optional fragments selected from fragment_files. Assembled in priority order and prepended AHEAD of instructions.

instructions.description: The writing coach's system prompt. SERVER-ONLY: never sent to the browser, so it may describe the assessment criteria and coaching strategy.

placeholder.description: Optional starter text prefilled into the editor. Empty for a blank page.

model.description: The model that drives the feedback chat.

provider.description: The LLM provider serving the model. For Azure Foundry, model is the deployment name.

llm.description: The model and provider that back the writing coach.

id.description: Local alias for this library, referenced by each fragment's `file`.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL or relative path to the fragment library.

fragmentFileRef.description: A reference to a fragment library by alias + URL.

file.description: The alias of the fragment library this fragment is drawn from.

id.description: Fragment id inside the referenced library.

variables.description: Literal values passed into the fragment template.

bind.description: Accepted for compatibility but ignored by the current assembler.

required.description: Marker for important fragments. Accepted but not currently enforced.

fragmentRef.description: Selects one fragment from a referenced library.

variableValue.description: A literal variable value: a string, a boolean, or an array of strings.
